content: Xoossa Bonchuwa
Hastamantho laythan, oyddantho ageenan, ichashantho gallas, taani Koboora shaafan di7etida asaa giddon de7ishin saloti dooyetin, Xoossaa qoncethi be7as.
Kawoy Yo7akini di7etida ichashantho laythan, he ageenan ichashantho gallasan,
Kaldaaweta biittan Koboora shaafa matan de7iya taako, Buza na7aa, kahiniya Hizqeelako, Godaa qaalay yis; Godaa wolqay tana haaris.
Ta xeelliya wode gotey pudeha baggafe yishin be7as; wolqaama shaara giddofe wol7anthi bentees; iya yuushuwan de7iya saloy poo7is. Tama giddo baggay phooliya naase birata daanees.
Iya giddon oyddu de7on de7iya medhetethati de7oosona. Enta malay asa mala daanees.
Enta issuwas issuwas oyddu oyddu som7oynne oyddu oyddu qefey de7ees.
Enta geday sitti gis; enta tohoy mehe qincafile mela; he tohoti quchidi geeshshida naase biratada phoolees.
Enta qefiyape garsara oyddu baggara asa kushe daaniya kushey de7ees. He oyddu medhetethatas som7oynne qefey de7ees.
Enta qefey issoy issuwa bochees; enti ubbay yaa haa simmonna sitti gidi sinthe boosona.
Enta issuwas issuwas sintha baggara asa som7oy de7ees; ushacha baggara gaammo som7oy de7ees; haddirsa baggara boora som7oy de7ees; guye baggara argantha som7oy de7ees.
Enta qefey dhoqu gidi micetidi uttis; enta issuwa issuwa nam7u qefey nam7u baggara hanko medhetethata qefey bochees; nam7u qefey enta asatethaa kammees.
Enti ubbay sitti gidi sinthe boosona; yaa haa simmonna, Xoossa Ayyaanay biya soo awuka boosona.
Ha de7on de7iya medhetethata giddon issi eexiya tama bonqo daaneysi de7ees. He tamay sinthenne guye qaaxiya, eexiya xompe daanees; he tamay phoolees; iya giddofe wol7anthi keyees.
Ha de7on de7iya medhetethati wol7anthada sinthenne guye eeson simeretoosona.
Heko, ha oyddu medhetethata ta be7iya wode, enta miyen, sa7an de7iya gertota be7as; issi issi medhetetha miyen issi issi gertoy de7ees.
Ha gertoti al7o shuchada phoolosona; enti oydday medhoninne malan issoy issuwa daanosona. Issi gertoy hanko gertuwa giddora kanthidi aadhidaba daanees.
Enti biya wode oyddu baggafe awu simmidi baaneko yaa haa simmonna boosona.
Gitanne yashshiya oyddu gertoti de7oosona; he gertotas gaxi de7ees; he gaxaa yuushoy ayfen kumidi uttis.
Ha medhetethati biya wode, enta miyen de7iya gertoti genderetoosona. He medhetethati biittafe pude dendiya wode gertotika dendoosona.
Ayyaanay biya awuka enti dendidi boosona. Hessi haney, de7o Ayyaanay gertota giddon de7iya gishosa.
De7o Ayyaanay gertota giddon de7iya gisho, medhetethati biya wode gertoti boosona; medhetethati eqiya wode gertoti eqoosona; medhetethati biittafe pude dendiya wode gertoti entara dendoosona.
De7on de7iya medhetethata huuphe soope bolla baggara mastooteda phoolidi ayfe caddiya salo gufantho daaniyabay micetidi de7ees.
He salo gufanthuwafe garsa baggara enta qefey sitti gidi, issoy issuwako micetidi uttis. Enta ubbaas banta asatethaa kammiya nam7u nam7u qefey de7ees.

Medhetethati paalliya wode enta qefiya girsay haatha kixa guunthada, Ubbaa Danda7iya Xoossa qaaladanne daro olanchota kooshinchada haneysa si7as. Enti paalo aggiya wode banta qefiya shiishidi ekoosona.
Enti banta qefiya shiishi ekidi, he bessan eqidashin, enta huuphe soope bolla baggara de7iya salo gufanthuwafe bolla dhoqafe girsi si7etis.
Salo gufanthuwafe bolla baggara sanpare geetetiya al7o shuchafe medhetida araata daaneysi de7ees; araata daaneysa bolla ase daaneysi uttis.
Taani iya be7iya wode iyaw xeesse daaneysafe bolla baggay taman de7iya naase biratada phoolees. Iyape garsa baggay tama daanees; iya yuushon phooliya poo7oy de7ees.
Iya yuushuwan de7iya phooliya poo7oy ira wode shaaran eqiya zuulla daanees. Haysi Godaa boncho qoncethaa daanees. Taani hessa be7ida wode biittan duge gufannada issi qaala girsi si7as.
